name: DTC Adjustment Payment Sub Reason 2 Code
definition: Specifies the subtype of the payment adjustment.

SCPK.name: Accrual Claim Payment
SCPK.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an accrual claim payment related to a stock distribution payable on user defined date.

SACP.name: Accrued Interest Not Paid
SACP.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is that accrued interest was not previously paid to you for the redemption in this issue. This adjustment is to pay you for this accrued interest.

SACA.name: Accrued Interest Wrong Rate
SACA.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for the accrued interest previously paid to you was at the wrong rate. This adjustment is to correct that erroneous payment.

SRTJ.name: Additional Rights For Beneficial Owner
SRTJ.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for a distribution of additional rights for round up of fractions as requested for your beneficial owners.

SSRJ.name: Allocation Adjustment Due To Fractions Rounded Up By Agent
SSRJ.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an allocation adjustment due to fractions rounded up by the agent related adjustment.

SST6.name: Allocation Of DRPTEDS Instruction
SST6.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an allocation of dividend reinvestment shares - DRP/TEDS instruction @100%.

SARA.name: Assumed By Your Goodselves
SARA.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an allocation for a participant position that was assumed by your good selves paid on retired Participant number.

SAIA.name: Avoid Fiscal Payment
SAIA.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an adjustment to avoid fiscal payment.

SAPP.name: Called Certificates Accrued Erroneous Interest Charge Back
SAPP.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for certificates you deposited prior to publication date were subsequently called. The agent paid DTCC the principal redemption proceeds but erroneously paid you the accrued interest.

SCKS.name: Called Certificates Check In Participants Name Charge Back
SCKS.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for certificates you deposited prior to publication date were subsequently called. The agent paid DTCC the principal proceeds via check, but in your customer’s name. We are forwarding the check today. This adjustment is to charge you for the funds.

SSDK.name: Cash Due On DRP Share Allocation
SSDK.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for accrued cash due on DRP share allocation.

SSCK.name: Cash Due On Stock Dividend
SSCK.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for accrued cash due on a stock dividend adjustment made on user defined date.

SSJJ.name: Cash In Lieu Of Fractional Shares
SSJJ.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an adjustment for cash-in-lieu of fractional shares related adjustment.

SNNG.name: Cash On Increased Shares
SNNG.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an adjustment for cash on increased shares due to a stock distribution payable.

SSR6.name: Charge In Lieu Of Receipt Of Dividend Reinvestment
SSR6.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is that, as per your authorization, we are charging your account in lieu of receipt of dividend reinvestment related shares related adjustment.

SFLD.name: Announcement Deleted Or Fail Tracking
SFLD.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an announcement deleted for fail tracking related adjustment.

SABA.name: Allocation Of Baby Bonds Amount To Be Exited

SSD6.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an adjustment to your dividend reinvestment (DRP) position related adjustment.

SSDJ.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for a bond paying in baby bonds that are issued in minimum/incremental denominations. This is to adjust for the amount of pending unissued bonds.

SSBK.name: Cash Due On Accrued Stock Payment
SSBK.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an adjustment for cash due on an accrued stock payment.

SRDA.name: Change In Record Date
SRDA.definition: Adjustment sub-reason is for an allocation adjustment due to a change in the record date.

SFI9.name: Charge At Withholding Rate

SFAF.name: Charge For French Avoid Fiscal Tax Credit
